records.name: executive_summary
records.response_text:
- Exposure assessed using 3,219,311 current deduplicated buildings.  
- Fixed 2023 SA1 population used: 4,994,034.  
- Shaking model incorporates ten official GeoNet shaking surfaces.  
- Eight pre-2018 event-time counts are unsupported and were excluded.  
- Point-source mean absolute error (MAE) = 1.049 MMI.  
- Note: the MAE (1.049 MMI) is a known limitation of the point-source shaking estimates.

records.name: quality_review
records.response_text:
Controls look appropriate: using a half-open, building_id-deduplicated event-time lifecycle prevents overlap/duplicates; mapping pre-2018 event-times to NULL/not_supported avoids invalid historical timestamps; DuckDB and process RSS caps (512 MB and 768 MB) limit resource usage; using official surfaces for the local map ensures authoritative spatial data.

Residual risk: downstream consumers or joins that assume non-null, continuous event-time values may misinterpret NULL/not_supported as valid timestamps, causing incorrect aggregations or temporal joins. Mitigation: document the NULL semantics and enforce validation in downstream queries.
